name: Stolma Bridge
facts: Stolma Bridge, opened 14 November 1998, stretches 467 metres, featuring a record‑setting 301‑metre cantilever box‑girder main span that once topped the world’s longest in its class.
Engineered with low‑density concrete, the bridge’s hollow girders taper from 15 metres at the piers to 3.5 metres midspan, reducing weight while maintaining structural integrity.
The main span’s high‑strength concrete, weighing just 1,940 kilograms per cubic metre, was ballasted with gravel on the short end spans to balance the cantilevered design.
